ov: A large, heavy-bodied, non-venomous snake of tropical America, and a staple of pet collections. It’s the only animal commonly called by its scientific name in English.

why.p: Boa constrictors are frequently kept and bred in captivity.

fx: A very capable swimmer, it often lives along rivers and streams.
